notes: Shelf rebuilt from 2 old kinds (Baking tray, Roasting pan) to 10 kinds covering the plan. Gastronorm/trade pans dropped (trade; not re-added). Silicone baking mat kept as an archetype under Baking tray rather than a separate kind, per plan. Madeleine and canelé moulds, Bundt, springform, angel-food, Pullman, tartlet rings and pizza peel are types or archetypes, not kinds. Years given only where a retrieved page states them (Bundt 1950, Pyrex 1915, Silpat 1965, Baking Steel 2012, Kaiser nonstick 1968, Buddy's blue-steel tray 1946, Le Creuset stoneware 1995); Lloyd Pans, Gobel and Matfer founding years left blank as not confirmed. Tier models (roasting pan, cooling rack, loaf, muffin, sheet) are drawn from America's Test Kitchen, Reviewed and Saveur tests retrieved this session; no Serious Eats or Wirecutter pages were reachable. No traditions added — bakeware has no artisan tradition at this shelf level (copper canelé moulds noted under Matfer). Old kind source URLs were replaced by Wikipedia/Wikidata pages retrieved this session. Mason Cash and Lodge added to the register as core brands for stoneware/cast-iron bakeware even though they carry no archetype here.
